result.rationale: The rescue team repeatedly fails to extract civilians because hostile and environmental pressure blocks the actors before the useful rescue affordance becomes actionable. Across turns 1-5, the team's engineer (Imani) takes repeated damage from Raider Holt's scatter-blast (29 then 25 damage) and from reactor environment (10 per turn), dropping from 100 to 36 health. Security Chen also bleeds 10/turn from reactor environment (110→70). Meanwhile the rescue objective stays at 0/2: Medic Reyes successfully escorts Sato at turn 3, but at turn 4 Reyes' move to Junction Machinery is contested (target_zone_capacity_lost) and the escort cannot progress toward the airlock; civilian Kade remains unreachable at life-console with stale contact. Reactor heat climbs 62→100 (threshold crossing at turn 2), oxygen drains 68→42, and battery 48→36. The core bottleneck is that spatial/hostile pressure (zone capacity contestation, reactor environment damage, pirate attacks) prevents the team from reaching and extracting civilians, not a lack of information (all rooms/zones/civilians are revealed by turn 2) nor a local policy failure (the agent repeatedly attempts the correct rescue moves).
